verdict.line: You lose if you let her farm Q pokes and the game drag past level 11; you win if you land E into R before she can Skip 'n Slash or mist away.

brief.thesis: Gwen's entire defensive kit is one long-cooldown button: once W (Hallowed Mist) is down, Facebreaker's stun has no answer. Sett's job is to force that all-in window before her E (Skip 'n Slash) and W are both up again, since her only other tool is a cone poke that does nothing if you don't stand in it. The 602-game sample backs a real early edge (48.3% overall, lane and solo-kill advantage both Sett) that narrows if the lane goes long.

theirWindow.when: her W and E are both up
theirWindow.what: She can poke freely with Q (Snip Snip!)'s cone and either dash out with E (Skip 'n Slash) or vanish into W (Hallowed Mist) if you commit. Don't trade face-to-face here — let her waste Q charges into minions instead of you.

yourWindow.when: her W and E are both down
yourWindow.what: With Hallowed Mist and Skip 'n Slash both on cooldown she has no disengage. Land E (Facebreaker) for the stun and dump R (The Show Stopper) immediately — she cannot dash or mist out of it.

start.why: Highest-performing start (48.6% over 632 games, 85.1% pick) — the sustain and AD let you absorb Q ticks into Grit instead of just losing HP to her poke.

boots.why: Most-picked boots (52.8% pick) and the MR directly cuts down her Q, passive, and Needlework magic damage over the course of the lane.

core.why: The active closes the gap on her E (Skip 'n Slash) dash range and the slow keeps her locked for the Facebreaker/Show Stopper combo.
Shreds her armor once she starts buying tank items and stacks move speed to keep pace with her Q/E footwork.
Max-health and regen stack with Sett's missing-health passive regen, giving you the HP pool to eat Q pokes and still all-in.

situational.when: the enemy team has burst or CC that can punish you mid all-in
the game goes long and her A Thousand Cuts sustain starts outpacing your damage
you're struggling to close her E dash range with standard boots
she starts stacking early MR and you need on-hit DPS instead of raw burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Best-performing page in the data (45.8% win rate) — Conqueror's ramping adaptive force and healing let you out-sustain her Q poke long enough to reach the E-into-R kill window.

summoners.why: By far the dominant pick (93.7% pick rate, 47.9% win rate) — Ignite removes the healing from A Thousand Cuts on a landed all-in, and Flash extends your Facebreaker or Show Stopper engage range.

playing.title: Bait Q charges pre-6
playing.detail: Snip Snip! fires up to 6 cone snips with true damage in the center — stand near minions at range so she wastes charges on the wave instead of landing the true-damage tick on you.

playing.title: Track Grit before Haymaker
playing.detail: Haymaker passively stores damage taken as Grit — absorb a couple of her Q ticks before popping W so the shield and true-damage punch actually land as a real answer, not a reflex press.

playing.title: Only E when she's flanked
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if she's caught between you and something on the opposite side; if she's alone on one side it just slows her. Use minions or terrain to get her flanked before committing.

playing.title: Ult before her E is up
playing.detail: The Show Stopper carries her through the air and slams her — cast it the instant Skip 'n Slash is on cooldown so she can't dash out mid-animation.

playing.title: Don't chase into Hallowed Mist
playing.detail: Once she casts W she can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist. Treat it as a hard reset and reposition rather than blindly walking in to keep swinging.

playing.title: Rush Stridebreaker for the all-in
playing.detail: Build Stridebreaker first in the 52.2%-win-rate path before Black Cleaver and Overlord's Bloodmail — the active closes her dash range and slows her in place.

playing.title: Front-load damage past level 11
playing.detail: A Thousand Cuts scales her sustain and healing off you as the game goes on — past mid-game, win the trade with burst (E into R) rather than extended auto-trading.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the tactical reasoning around cooldown windows and trade sequencing is my own analysis layered on top.
